title: Managed Database: lifecycle and bank fees
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database lifecycle and bank fees applies to database charge. This fee branch applies only to setup, resumption, termination and bank return fee source type. Charge setup fee once for an activated holding, resumption fee per distinct completed restoration, termination fee for on-demand exit, and failed payment fee per completed bank return. An unexpired commitment exit instead bills the recorded remaining signed commitment liability in USD as its termination liability. Copy the exact source transition, customer authorization or bank notice reference; do not use a primary meter as fee evidence. A zero fee is waived without a financial event. The fee amount is the selected policy amount or recorded signed liability, rounded using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention, then taxed under tax calculation. The primary-usage branch of primary usage pricing and its posted meter gate apply only to source type primary; supplemental charges use the category meter policy. Already billed source occurrence and fee subtype make repetition read-only.
